title: Bridge Graphical Models: Coupling, Projection, and Current-Preserving Dynamics for Generative Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.19144v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous-time generative models are often built from endpoint-conditioned bridges, but generation requires a different object: a non-anticipative Markov decoder that only observes the current state and time. We identify this bridge-to-decoder compression as a structural bottleneck shared by diffusion models, flow matching, rectified flow, Schr\"odinger bridges, and field-based generative models. We introduce the \emph{Markovization gap}, the time-integrated conditional variance of the bridge velocity given the Markov state. It is the MMSE of predicting endpoint-conditioned motion from the information available to a sampler, and it measures an irreducible loss incurred before any neural network is trained. translated_title: 桥图模型：生成建模中的耦合、投影与电流保持动力学
translated_abstract: 连续时间生成模型通常基于端点条件桥构建，但生成过程需要一个不同的对象：一个仅观察当前状态和时间的非预期马尔可夫解码器。我们将这种桥到解码器的压缩识别为扩散模型、流匹配、整流流、薛定谔桥和基于场的生成模型共享的结构瓶颈。我们引入了“马尔可夫化间隙”，即给定马尔可夫状态时桥速度的时间积分条件方差。它是从采样器可用信息预测端点条件运动的MMSE，并衡量了在任何神经网络训练之前发生的不可减少的损失。为了使这一瓶颈在不同模型家族间可比，我们定义了“桥图模型”（BGMs），它将端点耦合、桥定律、马尔可夫投影和电流保持动力学表示分离为独立的组成部分。
tldr: 本文提出桥图模型（BGM）框架，量化了连续时间生成模型中桥到马尔可夫解码器的压缩瓶颈，并引入“马尔可夫化间隙”作为统一度量，以比较不同生成模型的固有信息损失。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Bridge Graphical Models (BGMs) to quantify the bridge-to-Markov-decoder compression bottleneck in continuous-time generative models, proposing the "Markovization gap" as a unified metric for comparing intrinsic information loss across model families.
